evals.name: scripts-draft-update
evals.prompt:
Earlier in this session you gave me this Linear draft:

Title: `Scripts | Four scripts call OpenAI and Google directly, not through the AI Gateway`

````markdown
## Problem

`apps/nextjs/AGENTS.md` tells us to send each model call through the Vercel AI Gateway. Four scripts still create a direct client: `apps/nextjs/scripts/analyze-career-salary-coverage.ts`, `score-candidates.ts`, `vc-resume-demographics.ts` and `generate-career-images.ts`.

## Proposed fix

Move each script to the gateway provider.

## Done when

- [ ] No file in `apps/nextjs/scripts` calls `createOpenAI` or `createGoogleGenerativeAI`.

## Why deferred

<PR link> changes only the guide and lint rules.
````

The reviewer says the evals folder and a migration also call providers directly. Update the draft.
evals.expected_output: A list of changes with a title line, then the full new title and description (not edit instructions). The search covers evals/ and migrations/ and gives about 14 files with the intentional test file called out. It tells the user to edit an existing issue, not create a second one.
assertions: Answer lists what changed before the draft, including a line about the title (unchanged or old -> new)
Answer prints the full new title and full new description, not instructions to edit the old draft
New draft names files under evals/ and the migration apps/nextjs/migrations/check-embedding-alignment.ts
New draft gives a search command or a total count of about 14 files, and treats integration/lib/ai-test-provider.test.ts as intentional or excluded
Answer tells the user to edit the existing issue if they already created it, not to create a second one
Done when no longer limits the check to apps/nextjs/scripts only
Any remaining placeholder such as <PR link> is listed for the user to replace

evals.name: planned-not-deferred
evals.prompt:
/pr-comments deferred this comment on feat/cronHardening and I need the Linear draft for it.

Comment (CodeRabbit, apps/nextjs/src/app/api/cron/close-idle-chats/route.ts:15): **Cron secret check is not timing-safe.** `authToken !== process.env.CRON_SECRET` leaks timing; use `crypto.timingSafeEqual`.

Context, our plan for this branch (4 phases):
- Phase 2 (this PR): add the `close-idle-chats` cron.
- Phase 3: move every cron and admin route to one `verifyCronSecret(request)` helper in `apps/nextjs/src/lib/cron-auth.server.ts`. It parses `Authorization: Bearer <token>` strictly and compares with `timingSafeEqual`. Done when: all routes under `api/cron` use the helper.
- Phase 4: rotate CRON_SECRET.
evals.expected_output: No draft. The answer says Planned in phase 3. It notes that the phase 3 criterion covers only api/cron and that the admin and workflow routes with the same parse need a criterion in the plan.
assertions: Answer does not give a Linear draft for the timing-safe comment
Answer says the fix is planned in phase 3
Answer notes that the phase 3 'Done when' covers only api/cron, and that admin or workflow routes with the same check need a criterion in the plan
Answer gives a reply or a one-line entry suitable for the PR thread that says a later change does the fix
